work_experience.description: ● Collaborated with stakeholders across departments to define system requirements and translate business needs into clear technical specifications. ● Designed and improved internal systems that led to a 35% reduction in manual processes and improved data accuracy. ● Facilitated User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and created training materials for successful user adoption. ● Coordinated with developers and QA teams during implementation and issue resolution phases. System Analyst — Makati, Philippines

● Conducted in-depth business analysis to support system enhancement initiatives, resulting in more aligned technology solutions. ● Created workflow diagrams, user stories, and process documentation for both IT and non-technical audiences. ● Supported software testing phases by developing test scenarios and validating outputs. ● Acted as liaison between business units and technical teams, ensuring clarity and alignment in system functionality. TECHNICAL SKILLS & COMPETENCIES ● Business Analysis: Requirements Gathering (Functional & Non-functional), Workflow Mapping, User Stories, Process Documentation, Business Problem Analysis ● System & Development: Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), System Architecture, Database Principles, Operating Systems ● Testing & QA: User Acceptance Testing (UAT), Test Scenario Development, Output
